evidence_framework.purpose: Systematic collection, validation, and presentation of proof that supports transformation claims, builds trust, and demonstrates mechanism effectiveness.

examples.example: Revenue increase: $X to $Y over Z timeline
Time to result: First win in 7 days vs 30+ days typical

tier.name: Qualitative Transformation
tier.description: Identity shifts, behavior changes, breakthrough moments

examples.example: "I went from overwhelmed to confident in my ability to launch"
"This changed how I think about my business entirely"

tier.validation_required: Video testimonials, detailed written stories, permission to share

tier.name: Mechanism Proof
tier.description: Evidence that specific mechanism/method drives results

examples.example: "The Fast Track system was the key - I'd tried funnels for months"
"Once I applied the 4-layer model, everything clicked"
"Your framework gave me the structure I was missing"

tier.validation_required: Explicit connection between method and outcome

tier.name: Process Proof
tier.description: Evidence system works, not just individual effort/luck

structure.element: Avatar details (without identifying info if private)
Starting point (specific pain, situation, past failures)
Intervention (what they did, what you provided)
Mechanism attribution (why this worked when others didn't)

quality_criteria.criterion: Specific numbers and timelines (not vague "better results")
Passes Heart Test (not cherry-picked or manipulated)

collection_protocol.step: Track milestones in real-time (not reconstructed later)
Interview at transformation moment (while emotion fresh)
Validate claims with screenshots/data if quantitative
Get written approval for specific use cases

format.name: Video
format.talking_points: What you struggled with, what changed, specific result, who this is for

format.name: Audio
format.structure: Story arc: before → during → after → insight

collection_triggers.trigger: When they naturally share wins in community

category.name: Results
category.metric: Milestone achievement rate (% hitting each milestone)

category.name: Business Health
category.metric: Scalability (can quality be maintained at 2x volume?)

element.name: Progress Shares
element.description: Screenshots of customer wins shared publicly
element.sources: Community posts, tagged social media, email replies
element.use_cases: Social media content, sales page trust builders

element.name: Comparison Data
element.description: How results compare to industry averages or alternatives
element.validation: Must be fair, documented, and verifiable

element.name: Milestone Celebrations
element.purpose: Build belief in possibility, showcase diversity of wins

approach.name: 72-Hour Validation
approach.step: Identify specific pain through Reddit/community listening
Create landing page with mechanism preview

approach.name: Pilot Cohort
approach.step: Track completion rates, milestone velocity, feedback
Refine before scaling based on real usage data
Convert pilot participants to case studies

approach.name: A/B Testing
approach.sample_size: Minimum 100 per variant for statistical significance

trigger.template: Celebration + simple form (what changed, specific result, would you recommend)

questions.question: What's your biggest takeaway?
On a scale of 1-10, how likely are you to use this immediately?

trigger.action: Tag for potential case study if breakthrough moment
trigger.criteria: Customer reports major insight or result

interview_protocol.when: After major transformation, at program completion
interview_protocol.format: Video call (recorded with permission) or async written

questions.question: Where were you before starting? (specific pain)
What had you tried that didn't work?
What was your first breakthrough moment?
What specific results have you achieved? (quantitative)
How has this changed how you think/feel/act? (qualitative)
What part of the method/system was most valuable?
Who would you recommend this to?
What would you tell someone considering this?

data_capture.method: Before/after screenshots requested at onboarding and milestones
Progress tracking in customer dashboard (automated data collection)
Community win shares tagged and archived
Support transcripts analyzed for breakthrough language

framework.name: Story Before Statistics
framework.use_when: Email sequences, social content, video sales letters

objection.evidence: Diversity of case studies (different niches, experience levels)
Mechanism-attributed testimonials ("I tried X, Y, Z but THIS worked because...")
Timeline data (first win in X days, full transformation in Y)
Video testimonials, screenshot proof, third-party mentions

framework.name: Milestone Showcase

structure.element: Beyond 90 days: Sustained results (demonstrates lasting change)

framework.use_when: Program pages, onboarding sequences, community motivation

heart_test.question: Is this proof authentic and unmanipulated?
Would the customer recognize themselves in this presentation?
Am I cherry-picking outliers or showing typical results?
Are timelines and effort levels honestly represented?
Would I feel good if prospects saw my full data?

ethical_guidelines.guideline: Always get explicit permission before sharing customer stories
Disclose atypical results clearly ("This is unusually fast...")
Include range of outcomes, not just best cases
Acknowledge effort required, not just results achieved

validation_checklist.check: Story reflects typical journey (or labeled as exceptional)

stage.name: Curation
stage.activity: Tag by avatar, outcome type, use case

skill.name: Sales Page Copywriter
skill.provides: Testimonials formatted for credibility, case studies for mechanism proof
skill.format: Structured proof blocks ready for page insertion

skill.name: Email Campaign Genius
skill.provides: Customer story excerpts for sequence content, quick win examples for motivation
skill.format: Email-length testimonials with natural integration points

skill.name: Product Creation Genius
skill.provides: Validation data for product decisions, completion rate benchmarks

skill.name: Market Intelligence Synthesizer
skill.provides: Avatar-specific proof (shows it works for "people like me")

awakening_protocol.when: Evidence Pack activates (testimonial request, proof gathering)

wake_to_L1.skill: Product Creation Genius (may need milestone definitions)
Market Intelligence Synthesizer (may need avatar language)
Sales Page Copywriter (likely consumer of proof)

conversion_impact.metric: Email click rates when story-driven vs feature-driven
Objection handling success rate with proof vs without
conversion_impact.baseline: Track and optimize proof presentation based on actual conversion data

collection_efficiency.metric: Time from request to approved asset
Percentage of customers who become case studies
collection_efficiency.target: 30%+ response rate, <7 days to approval, 20%+ case study conversion

version.milestone: Complete EVIDENCE_PACK schema with all components
Evidence hierarchy, types, collection systems defined
Quality assurance and ethical guidelines established
Metrics tracking and repository structure specified
